en.tutorial0: Use the arrow keys to move
en.tutorial1: If you step on a purple square or a hazard, the stage will restart
en.tutorial2: Collect atoms and transform into a new chemical compound to complete the stage
en.tutorial3: You can step back onto purple squares if you have enough Step Coins
en.tutorial4: You can create your own formula if the stage does not have enough elements and you have enough atoms.
en.tutorial5: Press Space if you need to restart the stage at any point
en.tutorial6: Transform into different slime types to overcome any hazard in your way
en.tutorialatom1: Now you can choose the element you want and create a new chemical compound
en.tutorialatom2: Move with the arrow keys and choose with Spacebar to create the correct element
en.tutorialatom3: From now on if you get an blank atom you will have to create your own formula on the Fusion Menu
en.tutorialhint: Get a hint to solve the level
en.tutorialmenu: Press Enter to open the hint menu
en.hazard2: The wind is too cold and can change the results of the formula
en.hazard3: Strong winds can change your position
en.iron2: A good conductor of heat and electricity
en.water2: Absorbs heat and is a good conductor of electricity
en.snow1: Ice is denser than liquid water in solid form
en.snow2: It is frozen solid, making its particles tightly packed together
en.dioxide1: Humans and animals breathe it out
en.dioxide2: Being a heavy gas, it can float above lighter gases
en.magnetite1: It has been found in meteorites
en.movewith: Use the arrow keys to move
en.escapegame: Press Escape to exit the game
en.reach: Enter the portal to go to the next level
en.princess1: The princess has used her power and summoned elemental particles into the world
en.princess2: Use the elements to transform and rescue the princess

es.tutorial0: Usa las flechas del teclado para moverte

es.tutorial3: Puedes volver a pisar cuadros morados si tienes suficientes Monedas de Paso
es.tutorial4: Puedes crear tu propia fórmula si la fase no tiene suficientes elementos y tienes los átomos necesarios
es.tutorial5: Presiona Espacio si necesitas reiniciar la fase en cualquier punto
es.tutorial6: Transfórmate en diferentes tipos de slime para superar cualquier peligro en tu camino

es.tutorialatom2: Muevete con las flechas y selecciona con la barra espaciadora para crear el element correcto
es.tutorialatom3: Apartir de ahora si consigues un atomo en blanco tendras que crear tus propias formulas en el menu
es.tutorialhint: Obtén una pista para resolver el nivel

es.hazard4: Se aproxima una tormenta de arena
es.iron1: El núcleo de la Tierra está compuesto principalmente de hierro

es.water1: Necesaria para toda forma de vida conocida

es.dioxide2: Al ser un gas pesado, puede flotar sobre gases más ligeros
